name: Sausage & Biscuit Gravy
desc: Creamy pork sausage gravy spooned over split buttermilk biscuits.

source.title: Unbeatable Sausage Gravy and Biscuits
source.evidence: Same dish built on a 16.3 oz can of Grands biscuits with a sausage, flour and milk gravy whisked until thick; Pillsbury uses 12 oz raw bulk sausage, 1/3 cup flour and 3 cups milk.

ingredients.raw: 1 (16.3 oz) can Pillsbury Grands refrigerated buttermilk biscuits (8 count)
1 (9.6 oz) package fully cooked pork sausage crumbles
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Bake the biscuits according to the can directions (Pillsbury bakes Grands at 375°F).
Meanwhile, cook the sausage crumbles in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until hot and lightly browned, 5 to 6 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the sausage and stir until no dry flour remains, about 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until the gravy comes to a boil and thickens.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer 2 minutes, stirring. Season with salt and pepper.
Split the warm biscuits and spoon about 1/3 cup gravy over each biscuit.
tips: Precooked crumbles release little fat, so if the flour looks dry and clumpy, stir in 1 tbsp butter or oil before adding the milk.

references.title: Unbeatable Sausage Gravy and Biscuits
references.usedFor: 375°F biscuit bake, whisking the flour in before the milk

references.title: Sausage Gravy: Easy and Creamy
references.usedFor: topping up the drippings with oil to 1 tbsp before the flour
